segments.text: PDFC CNN gives React developers a shad CN style component registry for generating PDFs without starting every document from raw layout primitives. You
copy components into your codebase, customize themes, and props, then compose tables, forms, charts, invoices, and reports with either Tacumi or Form.
The documentation renders live previews, so changes are visible before export.
It's a component collection rather than a hosted editor.
